events.name: The Honest Hawker
events.intro: A hawker waves a single potion in the air. "One item, exact shop price, no tricks! Say thanks and I throw in a berry."

success.text: "Thank you!" you say. He beams and tosses a berry on top.
Fair price, polite words, a free berry.
"Always a pleasure!" He presses a berry into your hand anyway.

events.name: The Barter Barge
events.intro: A flat barge piled with crates drifts by the dock. "No coins here. Hand me two items, I hand you one better."

choices.label: Swap a Potion and a berry for a hold item

success.text: The deckhand weighs your offer and nods. The deal is struck.

choices.label: Swap a Poké Ball and a Potion for a strong item

success.text: Two small items go in the basket. A better one comes out.

choices.label: Swap a Potion and a Poké Ball (Charisma)

success.text: You talk the trade up a tier. The deckhand grumbles but pays.

failure.text: He only pays a plain item for the pair.

success.text: The barge drifts on.

events.name: The Mismatched Socks Sale
events.intro: A stall of footwear, every pair odd. "Speed boots! Left one is a size nine, right one a size six. Still fast!"

success.text: One boot does not quite fit, but you feel quicker. Three X Speed charges come with them.
A single boot. It helps a little, once.
You leave. The seller sighs and shuffles his boots.

events.name: The Coupon Clipper
events.intro: A woman with a binder full of coupons beams at you. "Thirty percent off! Next shop only. Do not lose it."

success.text: You pocket the coupon. It will work at the next shop you visit.
She is delighted and hands you a coupon for free.

failure.text: You mix up the piles. She takes your help as a joke and gives you a smaller coupon.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Subscription Box
events.intro: A courier thrusts a clipboard at you. "Pay once, and a surprise item arrives after each of your next three battles!"

success.text: The courier stamps your card. Deliveries start soon.
One small parcel now, nothing after.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: A Parcel for You
events.intro: The courier is back with a neat box. "Your subscription! Surprise!"

success.text: Something nice, wrapped carefully. The courier waves goodbye.

events.name: The Layaway Lady
events.intro: A shopkeeper with a ledger taps a locked case. "Half now, the rest is ours. It will be with you in a couple of towns."

choices.label: Put a rare item on layaway (₽400)

success.text: She writes your name in the ledger. "Two more stops, dear."

choices.label: Put a lesser item on layaway (₽150)

success.text: A smaller deal, a smaller wait.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Your Layaway Is Ready
events.intro: The Layaway Lady waves at you across the street. "It has arrived, dear!"

success.text: She hands over a sealed case. It was worth the wait.

events.name: Your Layaway Is Ready (Small)
events.intro: The Layaway Lady flags you down with a paper bag. "The small one is here!"

success.text: A tidy package with a handwritten receipt.

events.name: The Rental Counter
events.intro: A counter with a "Hold Items for Rent" sign. "Five battles, then it comes back to me. Do not scratch it."

success.text: You hand over the fee. The orb hums in your pocket.
The scarf fits. Speed is yours for a short while.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Rental Is Due
events.intro: The Rental Counter clerk jogs up, out of breath. "Time is up! I need that item back."

success.text: He checks it for scratches and nods.
He smooths the fabric and thanks you.
He sighs and bills you for the item.
You bolt. He shouts something about a fee.

events.name: The Price Match Guy
events.intro: A man shows you a worn notebook. "Cheapest price I ever saw. Bring me a deal and I will match it for one item."

success.text: He matches it. A fair deal, written in his notebook.
"Never saw it cheaper." He hands over a Revive.
Three Ultra Balls for a price he swears is the lowest in town.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Bulk Buyer
events.intro: A buyer in a hard hat holds a calculator. "I sell nothing. I pay double for stacks of identical things."

success.text: He counts it twice, then pays double.
A tidy item. The buyer pays a strong price.
He weighs the ball and nods.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Wholesale Warehouse
events.intro: A warehouse with stacked pallets. "Five of anything, steep discount. No singles."

success.text: A pallet of potions, heavy and cheap.
A strong stack for a small price.
A crate of balls for the road.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Clearance Rack of Doom
events.intro: A crooked rack, a hand-painted "90% OFF" sign. "One of these is cursed. Which one? Nobody knows."

success.text: Cheap. You feel a little odd afterward.

failure.text: It was the cursed one. Your Pokémon shudder.

success.text: A bagful of bargains and a bad feeling.

failure.text: Cursed. The whole bag smells of old socks and bad luck.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Auction Pop-up
events.intro: A pop-up auction: an NPC in a suit, a smug rival, and a Rocket grunt in sunglasses. The lot is a sealed crate.

success.text: You outbid the suit. The grunt scowls, the rival laughs.

failure.text: The suit raises. You lose the lot and keep your coins.

success.text: Everyone drops out. The crate is yours.

failure.text: The rival bids ₽900. You walk away poorer in pride only.

success.text: Silence. Then the gavel. The crate holds treasure.

failure.text: The grunt snatches the lot and runs. You lose nothing.

success.text: You enjoy the shouting and walk on.

events.name: The Silent Auction
events.intro: A quiet room with slips of paper and a locked case. "Write your bid. Closest to the hidden value wins."

success.text: Your slip is the closest. The item is yours.

failure.text: Someone guessed closer. The slip is returned.

success.text: Right on target. The clerk hands over the case.

failure.text: Too high. You lose the money on a rare mistake.

success.text: Almost exact. A grand prize.

failure.text: Way over. The winner pays less. You gain nothing.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Raffle Seller
events.intro: A kid with a drum of paper tickets. "Win a tier-three item! The more tickets, the better your odds."

success.text: Your number comes up! A shiny prize.

failure.text: A lucky stranger wins. You get nothing.

success.text: Your number comes up! A shiny prize.

failure.text: Not today. The kid offers you a consolation berry.

success.text: A whole fistful, and one of them wins.

failure.text: So many tickets, so little luck. A berry for the effort.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Pawn Sharks
events.intro: Two men in sharp suits lean on a counter. "Sell it now. Buy it back later. We mark it up. It is only business."

success.text: They take the item and hand you cash. "Come see us again."
A small pawn. They smile too widely.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Pawn Sharks Again
events.intro: The same two men corner you outside a shop. "Want your item back? It will cost more now."

success.text: They hand it over without a smile.
"Business is business."

events.name: The Pawn Sharks Again (Berry)
events.intro: The pawn sharks tip their hats. "That berry, friend. Still want it?"

success.text: A slightly bruised berry returns to your bag.
They shrug and move on.

events.name: The Street Tailor
events.intro: A tailor with a mouthful of pins and a measuring tape. "Let me swap your outfit. A small perk comes with the new look."

success.text: You look the part. People listen.
Sturdy boots and a tough coat.
A neat cut and deep pockets.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Charm Tinkerer
events.intro: A tinkerer hunches over a desk of bells and beads. "Two charms in, one blended charm out. Weaker, but it hums."

success.text: Gears whir. A single faint charm comes out.
A soft glow and a smaller catch bonus.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Mystery Meat Cart
events.intro: A cart with a hot plate and a handwritten menu. "Cheap, hearty, and probably meat."

success.text: Your team wolfs it down and feels sturdier.

failure.text: The skewer was off. Your team wolfs it anyway and pays for it.

success.text: A feast fit for a party. Everyone feels better.

failure.text: The feast was off. Your team is miserable.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Poké Ball Pitchman
events.intro: A pitchman bangs a table. "The Mega-Gripper! The Sure-Snatch 3000! The Whisper Ball! Call now and get a second free!"

success.text: A stout ball with a firm hinge. You get a second for free.
Loud paint and a flashy sticker. It works, mostly.
A pale ball that makes no sound. Three come in the box.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Vending Machine
events.intro: A glowing vending machine hums by the road. Something rattles inside.

success.text: Clunk. A drink rolls out.
Clunk-clunk. A hearty haul drops.

choices.label: Shake it for a free one

success.text: Something big drops out. The machine shivers.

failure.text: An angry Rotom bursts out of the machine and zaps your team.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Capsule Gacha
events.intro: A toy machine with a crank. "Each spin: a random cosmetic or a tiny perk."

success.text: A capsule pops open: a tiny charm!
Five capsules, a pile of trinkets and a nice surprise.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Flea Market Fossil
events.intro: A hobbyist guards a gray lump on a rickety table. "Real fossil! Or a rock. The reveal costs money."

success.text: It is a fossil, and a good one.

failure.text: Just a rock. The hobbyist shrugs.

choices.label: Pay a lot for the best tools (₽500)

success.text: A perfect fossil and a Revive tucked inside.

failure.text: A rock and a story about a rock.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Bait Shop Bargain
events.intro: A bait shop owner winks. "Lures that raise your odds of rare finds. Good for three stops."

success.text: A lure for the road. Rare finds feel closer.
A tackle box of lures.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Repel Reseller
events.intro: A shifty man peels open a coat of spray bottles. "Expired Repels. Half effect, dirt cheap."

success.text: It smells a bit off, but it works.
A discount bundle, all expired.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Scalper Alley
events.intro: A scalper holds a tier-three item high. "Triple price. Take it or leave it. Or haggle, if you can."

success.text: You pay the premium. It stings and it works.
You haggle him down to a decent price.

failure.text: He laughs and raises the price. You walk away.

success.text: You flag a patrol. A reward comes through the post.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Estate Sale
events.intro: A house full of items, a sign reading "Everything must go". A relative stands in the doorway with crossed arms.

success.text: You pick two. The relative glares at your back.

failure.text: The relative drags you out. You leave with one item.

choices.label: Take one item and thank her

success.text: She softens and lets you take a keepsake as well.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Retired Champion's Garage Sale
events.intro: A retired champion sits among old trophies. "Three signature items for sale. I will not need them where I am going."

success.text: A scarf that has seen many finals.
The champion's belt, still creased from use.
A sash that survived a hundred hits.
A long story, a small gift.

events.name: The Gift Wrap Station
events.intro: A booth with ribbons and tape. "Wrap an item and hand it to the next person you meet. They will remember."

success.text: A tidy bow. It will find its recipient.
A cheerful ribbon on a plain Potion.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Gift Returned
events.intro: A stranger waves you down, holding your wrapped gift. "A friend sent this ahead. They said you would pass by."

success.text: The stranger grins. "A gift for a gift!"

events.name: The Delivery Rider
events.intro: A rider in a helmet hands you a package. "Carry this three stops. Do not open it. Payment on delivery."

success.text: You tuck the parcel carefully into your Bag.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Parcel Is Due
events.intro: A familiar rider waits at a crossing. "Did you bring it?"

success.text: "Perfect." Payment and a thank-you.
You peek. The rider glares. Inside: a decent item. You keep it.

events.name: The Pawn Berry Smoothie
events.intro: A smoothie bar run out of a cart. "Blend three berries into a temporary buff drink."

success.text: A rich blue drink. Your lead feels strong.
A wild purple drink. Your team feels sharp.
Fresh and cold.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Mobile Poké Mart Truck
events.intro: A truck pulls over for one node only. Its stock is random, the driver says, and tomorrow it will be gone.

success.text: The driver tosses in whatever is on the shelf.
A full crate rattles out.
You browse. The driver tips his cap.

events.name: The Black Friday Stampede
events.intro: A crowd stampedes a shop opening. "First pick goes to whoever pushes the hardest!"

success.text: The crowd turns and a shopper swarm swings at you. Fight for first pick!

choices.label: Wait for the crowd to thin (Luck)

success.text: The crowd drifts off. You pick the leftovers.

failure.text: Nothing is left but a bent shelf.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Counterfeit Charm Cop
events.intro: A cop eyes a charm vendor. "That charm is a fake. I need a witness. Or you could buy a fake cheap."

success.text: The cop thanks you and slips you a reward.
A fake charm. It does something odd, anyway.

failure.text: Totally fake. The seller laughs and the cop watches.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Magnet Salesman
events.intro: A salesman stands among floating Magnemite. "Gadgets that pull coins toward you. Slightly magnetic, slightly cursed."

success.text: A gadget hums. Coins feel drawn to your pocket.
A stronger gadget, noisy and heavy.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Smuggler's Crate
events.intro: A smuggler pats a stenciled crate. "Unopened. Contents may include a banned item. No refunds."

success.text: The crate holds a haul of gear. A patrol passes you without looking.

failure.text: Banned goods. A patrol confiscates the crate and fines you.

success.text: The patrol thanks you with a reward.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Rebate Booth
events.intro: A booth with a hand-drawn "REBATE" sign. "Refund of twenty percent of your last purchase."

success.text: The clerk counts out some coins.
The clerk sighs and counts out more.

failure.text: "Rebate denied." You are shown out.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Bank Teller
events.intro: A teller behind brass bars. "Deposit now. At the next bank stop, you will get ten percent back."

success.text: The teller stamps your slip. "See you later."
A heavier slip, a bigger smile.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Teller Returns
events.intro: The same teller waves from an open window. "Your deposit has matured."

success.text: You get your money back, with interest.

events.name: The Teller Returns (Big)
events.intro: The teller waves a thick envelope. "Interest at last."

success.text: A thick envelope of cash.

events.name: The Currency Exchanger
events.intro: A counter with two glass jars. "Money to Battle Points, or back again. Rates posted on the wall."

success.text: Four hundred coins turn into research notes.
Notes turn into coins.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Mismatched Mart
events.intro: A mart stocking only one type's items today. A wall calendar tracks the rotation.

success.text: Today it is all fire: lures and charcoal.
Today it is all water: lures and mystic water.
Today it is all grass: lures and seeds.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Seller of Second Chances
events.intro: A pale seller shakes a velvet bag. "Regret something? For a fee I let you undo your last choice. Once."

success.text: The seller whispers. The memory shifts.
A fainter shift. You feel lighter.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Quiet Antiquarian
events.intro: An old man arranges small relics on a cloth. He speaks softly of kings and storms.

success.text: A quiet story, and a small relic pressed into your hand.
A handsome piece of the past.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Itinerant Moves Tutor
events.intro: A traveling tutor teaches one move per visit. His price is odd: a berry, a coin, or a secret.

success.text: He taps a TM from his pack and nods.
A coin for a lesson. He is fine with that.
You whisper a secret. He smiles and teaches a rare lesson.

failure.text: Your secret is dull. He teaches a plain lesson.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Retired Gym Merch Stall
events.intro: A stall of type-themed badge pins from retired gym leaders. "Each pin carries a tiny type boost."

success.text: A bright red pin.
A blue pin that never dries.
A green pin with a tiny leaf.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Sock Puppet Salesman
events.intro: A salesman wearing a floppy hat sells you an item. Something is off about his shadow. It looks very much like a Mimikyu.

success.text: You buy it. It works. His shadow looks pleased.
"Mimikyu!" you shout. The disguise flops and the salesman springs at you.

failure.text: You miss it. The seller sells you a plain item and slips away.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Trade Wind Caravan
events.intro: A caravan of three merchants parks by the road. "You may trade with only one of us. Choose carefully."

success.text: She trades a bundle of berries for a coin.
He swaps a hold item for a coin.
He asks a lot, and gives a lot.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Stolen Goods Stall
events.intro: A stall of questionable bargains. "Cheap, cheap! Do not ask where it came from."

success.text: You pocket something nice. It might be hot.
A strong item at a thief's price.
The patrol thanks you.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Rocket Grunt Wants It Back
events.intro: A Rocket grunt steps in front of you. "That item you bought. It was ours. Hand it over."

success.text: He takes it and leaves. Fair enough.
"No way," you say. He throws a ball.

events.name: The Apothecary Experiment
events.intro: A lab-coated apothecary offers a bubbling vial. "Test-drink a random potion. I pay you for the data."

success.text: It fizzes and works. You are paid and refreshed.

failure.text: It burns your tongue. You are still paid for the data.

success.text: A deep green glow and a stronger buff.

failure.text: The vial was bad. A coin for your trouble.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Final Sale Banner
events.intro: A banner reads "EVERYTHING ₽1". The stall owner clears his throat. "First, you will sit through a short skit."

success.text: The skit takes forever, but the shelves empty into your arms for a coin.
You charm your way past the skit.

failure.text: He sulks and refuses to sell.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.
